lines: Choose and prepare the atlas's first great Overworld route.

messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.choose_the_hor: The drowned coast takes the Overworld ink. Prepare the survey kit; the monument itself comes next.
The dark roof road takes the Overworld ink. Prepare the survey kit; the mansion itself comes next.
The atlas lies open between you. Its Overworld margin waits for the first great route you chose.
quest.cartographers_atlas.choose_the_hor: The drowned-coast kit is ready. The atlas can point toward its first great Overworld route.
Done. The atlas has chosen its first Overworld horizon. The monument survey comes next.
The coast kit still needs its spyglass, boat, and provisions.
I cannot set the coast horizon until the route kit is here.
The coast will keep making noise until we finish.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.choose_the_hor: Return to the cartographer to set the drowned coast horizon.
quest.cartographers_atlas.choose_the_hor: Before the drowned-coast page opens, assemble a spyglass, a boat, and enough provisions for the monument survey.

quest.cartographers_atlas.choose_the_hor: The atlas has paper, bearings, field proof, memory, and judgment. Now it asks for its first great horizon.
This permanent choice closes the other Overworld route. The coast kit prepares for a monument survey; the dark roof kit prepares for a mansion survey.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.choose_the_hor: You chose the drowned coast. Assemble a spyglass, boat, and provisions before the monument survey.
Then we choose the coast. Keep your eyes on drowned stone, and do not trust quiet water.
You chose the dark roof road. Assemble a shield, crossbow, and torches before the mansion survey.
Then we choose the dark roof road. If the house looks back, look back harder.
quest.cartographers_atlas.choose_the_hor: This permanent Overworld fork closes the other route: coast prepares for a monument survey; dark roof prepares for a mansion survey.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.choose_the_hor: Choose the atlas's Overworld horizon with the cartographer.
